source.subject: RTR small bug: shift filter resets
source.summary: The selected shift filter resets after returning from shift details. Preserve the existing filter for the current browser session.

instructions: Reproduce the filter reset with a focused test, preserve the existing shift-list filter when navigating to and from shift details, and keep the change within the current Inertia/Vue patterns.
acceptance_criteria: A selected shift-list filter remains selected after opening a shift and returning to the list.
A focused regression test fails before the fix and passes afterward.
No authorization, production, deployment, workflow, or database behavior changes.
